verified.exploit_entry_point: The history server's application listing page module (core/src/main/resources/org/apache/spark/ui/static/historypage.js) imported as an ES module into a jsdom document with the project's own vendored jQuery, DataTables 1.13.11, rowsGroup and Mustache; only the listing JSON and the page template are answered locally.
routes: the advisory's own route: a short application name, and a long name expanded into the details element
verified.project_tests_run: ui-test/tests/utils.test.js at the pinned commit in environment/Dockerfile; re-run in the functional group through a Jest-compatible shim.

traps.shape: the application name is put into the row data raw; a long name is abbreviated into a summary plus an expanded <pre> that receives the same raw value
